title: Bootstrapping a scatter plot
statement:
To bootstrap the slope, each resample should be made by …

[_]{a}

choices: taking the first half of the rows
resampling whole rows (x, y pairs) with replacement
shuffling y while keeping x fixed
explanations: That breaks the pairs and destroys the relationship.
That simulates a flat line, not the slope's variability.

hints: The relationship lives in the pairs.
solution: Resample rows so each (x, y) pair stays together.
